description: The retained hash length is at least 128 bits.
note: THE REFERENCE IMPLEMENTATION CURRENTLY FAILS THIS: it retains 64 bits. Recorded as a known non-conformance rather than accommodated by lowering the clause. A second preimage at 64 bits is 2^64 work, reachable with commodity GPUs in months; at 128 bits nobody reaches it. That difference is the difference between evidence and evidence-shaped.
